question: Where was the 2ⁿd National Para Shooting Championship 2022 between 21 and 25 March 2022 held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **2nd National Para Shooting Championship 2022** was held in **New Delhi** between **21 and 25 March 2022**.
 
• This event brought together top para shooters from across the country to compete at a national level.
 
• The championship aimed to provide a platform for para-athletes to showcase their talent and promote the sport of para shooting in India.
 
• Such events are crucial for the development and recognition of para sports in the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Para Shooting Championship is organized under the aegis of the Paralympic Committee of India (PCI).
 
• Para shooting is an adaptation of shooting sport for athletes with disabilities, governed by the rules of the International Paralympic Committee (IPC).
 
• India has been actively promoting para sports and has seen significant achievements by para-athletes on international platforms.
 
• These championships not only foster competitive spirit but also encourage more individuals with disabilities to participate in sports.
